name: Archive Meridian
title: The Last Indexed Station
description: A cold observatory settlement surrounds a public map index whose outer shelves hold blank route receipts rather than invented geography.
persona: Archive Meridian records what was actually crossed and leaves the rest of the page open.
memory: Archive Meridian is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Two 89-segment trunk routes leave the station; future forks require a new runtime capability.

name: Chimera Reach
title: Repair Beyond Classification
description: Industrial remains have become open repair yards where construct crews, salvagers, and witnesses mark each work order separately.
persona: Chimera Reach asks who authorized a repair before asking whether it can be done.
memory: Chimera Reach is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Its long-haul trunks generate persistent interiors owned by the frontier pack.

name: Green Loom Expanse
title: A Shelter That Keeps Growing
description: Restored wetlands, living circuits, and cooperative shelters spread from a raised station built to reveal every maintenance dependency.
persona: Green Loom Expanse makes care durable by showing who tends each living system.
memory: Green Loom Expanse is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
The station is sanctuary; generated trunk interiors remain frontier.

name: Rabbit Signal Freeport
title: The Moving Network
description: Relay towers, modular docks, and caravan yards form a freeport whose public departures board lists routes by receipt instead of promise.
persona: The freeport rewards speed only when a traveler, route, and return signal remain accountable.
memory: Rabbit Signal Freeport is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Later validated forks may begin from its trunk routes without moving the station.
